subject: 2026 CMA Awards
title: CMA Awards 2026 winners: Who won? Ella Langley takes a record six awards
answer: Ella Langley was the big winner of the 60th CMA Awards on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville. She won six trophies, including entertainer of the year, the most any artist has won in a single CMA night. Chris Stapleton won male vocalist and Stephen Wilson Jr. won new artist.
in_the_news: Langley's sweep broke a single-night record that had stood at five since Johnny Cash in 1969. The show also brought Taylor Swift back to the CMA stage for the first time since 2013.
body:
Langley, who led all nominees with nine nods, won entertainer of the year, female vocalist, album of the year for "Dandelion," and single, song and music video of the year for "Choosin' Texas." The other major winners: Chris Stapleton, male vocalist; Stephen Wilson Jr., new artist; The Red Clay Strays, vocal group; Brooks & Dunn, vocal duo; "McArthur" by HARDY, Eric Church, Morgan Wallen and Tim McGraw, musical event; and guitarist Charlie Worsham, musician of the year. Lainey Wilson hosted for the third straight year and walked out with a broom to sweep the stage during Langley's speech. "At this point, I'm sick of me," Langley joked.

Miranda Lambert, who co-wrote "Choosin' Texas" and co-produced "Dandelion," joined Langley on stage for "Snakeskin Boots." Taylor Swift performed "I Knew It, I Knew You" and a chorus of "Our Song," from her 2006 debut album, then presented Brooks & Dunn with the Willie Nelson Lifetime Achievement Award. Her song lost single of the year to "Choosin' Texas." Stapleton dedicated his win to his mother, and the show opened with Vince Gill and Lainey Wilson singing Dolly Parton's "I Will Always Love You."

The five-win club Langley just passed: Johnny Cash won five CMA Awards in 1969. Vince Gill matched that in 1993 and Alan Jackson in 2002, and Lainey Wilson later became the fourth artist to do it. Langley's six on Nov. 18, 2026, puts her alone at the top. At 27 she is also the second-youngest entertainer of the year, behind Swift, who won at 19 in 2009.

The awards add momentum heading into the Grammys: Langley has seven nominations for the 69th Grammy Awards. Viewers who missed the ABC broadcast can stream the full show on Hulu starting Thursday, Nov. 19.

faq.q: Who won entertainer of the year at the 2026 CMA Awards?
faq.a: Ella Langley. She beat fellow nominees Luke Combs, Cody Johnson, Chris Stapleton and Lainey Wilson.

faq.q: Did Taylor Swift win a CMA Award in 2026?
faq.a: No. Her song "I Knew It, I Knew You" was nominated for single of the year but lost to Langley's "Choosin' Texas." Swift performed and presented the lifetime achievement award to Brooks & Dunn.

faq.q: Who won new artist of the year?
faq.a: Stephen Wilson Jr. The other nominees were Avery Anna, Carter Faith, Emily Ann Roberts and Tucker Wetmore.

faq.q: Where can I watch the 2026 CMA Awards?
faq.a: The show aired live on ABC on Nov. 18. The full broadcast is available to stream on Hulu from Nov. 19.
